title: A needle in the logs
brief: The app log is long and one line leaks a password. Use grep to find it instead of reading everything.
hint.1: grep <word> <file> prints only the lines that contain the word.
hint.2: Try grep -i password /var/log/app.log. -i ignores upper/lower case.
hint.3: The failed login line contains the password. That is the flag.
walkthrough: grep -i password /var/log/app.log, then submit the value.
debrief: Logs are a gold mine for defenders and attackers. Here a failed login logged the password in clear text. Defenders: never log secrets, and use search tools to review logs fast.
